objective: Validate a gravity-aware tangent-frame cave anatomy compiler and build the corresponding whole-cave-split token corpus required by CW3 and CW4.

cw1_compiler.route_resampling: reverse gravity axis then exact 2x2x2 block maximum from 64 cubed to 32 cubed
cw1_compiler.frame: local PCA tangent; gravity projected into tangent-normal plane; deterministic fallback for vertical tangents; lateral is right-handed cross product
cw1_compiler.extent_measurement: nearest-neighbor rays at 0.25 voxel spacing in positive/negative up and lateral directions
cw1_compiler.field: hard union of local asymmetric tangent-frame superellipsoids

target_channels: positive and negative gravity-frame half extent
positive and negative lateral half extent
cw2_tokens.truncation: FORBIDDEN; dataset build fails if any patch exceeds the maximum

cw1_primary_gate.morphology: oracle tangent-frame compiler beats fitted single-radius sweep by the registered three-of-four and negative-mean-log rule on at least 4 of 5 folds
cw1_primary_gate.safety: all fields finite and protected-route survival exactly 1.0

cw2_primary_gate.token_count: all projected raw-route voxels retained without truncation
cw2_primary_gate.target_access: recorded true for corpus construction and forbidden for CW3/CW4 inference

claim_limit: five burned development caves; compiler and representation validation only
